notes.title: 80% OFF and new atmospheric post-apocalyptic shooter: R.O.V.E.R.
notes.content:
Right now there is a discount for Infernales: Circles of Hell and Infernales, and also on soundtracks! Have time to buy.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6319/InfernalesBundle/
Also want to tell you about new game from our colleague SoerGame: R.O.V.E.R. - First-person shooter, with elements survival, in post-apocalyptic setting, created in the spirit of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. and Fallout, as repeatedly mentioned in the reviews of players. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a lonely, slightly eerie, mysterious post-apocalypse in which you have to survive, hunt, help other survivors, and kill enemies and mutants.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/870160/ROVER/
